myApplications.title: My applications
myApplications.emptyTitle: You have not applied to any table
myApplications.emptyDescription: Browse the open tables and apply to the one you like.
myApplications.withdrawDescription: Your application to {{name}} will be withdrawn. To try again you will have to apply from scratch, and you lose your place in the queue.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.emptyDescription: Nobody has applied to this table yet.
candidates.order: The order is by application date and is never re-sorted
candidates.rejectDialogDescription: This cannot be undone. Explain why you are turning them down.
candidates.acceptConfirmDefault: Do you confirm this candidate joins the table?
candidates.acceptConfirmFillsTable: This acceptance fills the last seat: every remaining candidate will be rejected automatically.
candidates.rejectConfirmDescription: They get the rejection with your reason and stop being one of the table's candidates.

veto.requestDialogDescription: An admin decides. Say why: it is what they read to decide.
veto.requestEffect: Nothing changes yet: the person keeps playing and keeps seeing the table until an admin answers.
veto.requestSuccess: Request sent: an admin answers it
veto.unblockDialogDescription: They see the table again and go back to where they stood before the ban, if there is room. Say why you are lifting it: it is recorded just like the ban.
veto.unblockEffect: They get the table back as it was: it returns to their explorer, they can open it, download its files again, and recover their place. If the table filled up meanwhile, they are left as rejected for lack of seats and can apply again.

errors.NOT_PRIMARY_MASTER: Lifting a ban is decided by the table’s master or an admin.
errors.REGISTRATION_ALREADY_BLOCKED: That person is already banned from this table. Refresh to see how it stands.
errors.REGISTRATION_NOT_BLOCKED: That person is not banned: somebody lifted it before you did.
errors.generic: We could not complete the action. Try again.
errors.REQUEST_ALREADY_PENDING: A ban request on that person is already waiting for an answer. Refresh to see it.

veto.requestConfirmDescription: An admin decides. Until then they stay at the table.
veto.unblockConfirmDescription: They can see the table again; if it is full they are left as rejected for lack of seats. It is recorded with your reason.
